results.name: W walks Lumi while jumped in
While jumped in, the camera menu still counts: follow chases, orbit circles Lumi, free turns with the mouse
Sneeze: jumped in as Lumi, X sneezes and blows the friends nearby off their feet
Giant Lumi: M while jumped in grows Lumi 5x, W walks the giant, then it shrinks back
Flight: jumped in, G takes off and the camera keeps the flying Lumi in view every second
Storm: jumped in as Lumi, T calls a thunderstorm on you and a bolt strikes within 20 s, Lumi stays yours
Jumped in: the camera menu switches orbit and follow, and follow keeps Lumi in view
